svg.title: USB 2.0 to Nessum adapter - option C (hub + AX88772C + CP2102N)
svg.text: USB 2.0 bus-powered: ≤ 500 mA @ 5 V. Load estimate TBD from the hub / AX88772C / CP2102N / SC1320A datasheets.
Each IC: 100 nF per supply pin + 10 µF bulk, placed at the pins.
Fit only if neither the AX88772C nor the SC1320A
sources the 50 MHz RMII reference clock.
Reverse-RMII = AX88772C acts as the PHY side (MAC-to-MAC)
pin names are placeholders until the SC1320A datasheet
Linux: asix driver → eth2. Carrier is always up (no PHY link);
the Nessum link state is read over the CP2102N serial port.
Medium: existing RS-485 twisted pair OR 24 V AC/DC cable (SELV only, no mains).
C3/C4 pass 2–28 MHz and block 24 V DC / 50–60 Hz AC.
D1 must not conduct on 24 V AC peaks (~34 V).
24 V medium: fit RF chokes at each load and at the supply (spec §6.2).
1. Rev 0 = architecture schematic: every part and net, no pin numbers.
2. SC1320A / AX88772C / hub pin names are functional; exact names per datasheets.
3. Reverse-RMII: AX88772C is the PHY side, so RMII nets connect by name.
4. MAC in U4 (93C56/66): no write-protect pin on supported parts → root can change it.
5. Host can reach the SC1320A UART: key lock must be enforced by the SC1320A.
6. R22/R23 (0Ω): remove to cut host access to the UART if it cannot be locked.
Option C — USB hub + AX88772C + CP2102N (rev 0)
Host: TI AM62x (eth2) · no MCU · Nessum: SC1320A · see docs/ALTERNATIVES.md
